provenance.title: Mars 2020 Science Investigation CTX DEM Mosaic
provenance.extraction: Exact 500×500 source-pixel window; no resampling, smoothing, interpolation, hole filling or quantisation. Original float32 values retained as JSON numbers.

provenance.verticalReference: USGS describes added DEMs as vertically localised to MOLA. The GeoTIFF does not specify a vertical CRS; absolute vertical datum and uncertainty are not independently certified here.
provenance.coordinateNote: The GeoTIFF sphere radius is 3396190 m and its standard parallel is 18.4663°. These raster keys, not generic catalogue radii or equatorial scaling, define this subset.
limitations: 20 m terrain cannot resolve individual rocks, wheel-scale hazards, soft sand, or soil bearing capacity.
DEM grid spacing is not vertical accuracy.
Geographic alignment with other map products is not independently validated.
These are measured terrain elevations, not evidence of operational rover or crew safety.
